description: This file defines a full-screen video player page in a Flutter application, managing video playback, controls, and UI layout for playing videos, including handling loading, errors, and poster images.

classes.name: VideoPlayerScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides a route for the full-screen video player, expecting a VideoItem in route arguments.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerPage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the core video player page that manages video playback and user interface.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerPageState
classes.description: State class for _VideoPlayerPage, handling initialization, build, and user interactions, integrating with VideoPlayerProvider.

classes.name: _PosterPlaceholder
classes.description: A widget that displays a poster image (asset or network) as a placeholder before video loads.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Creates a route to navigate to the full-screen video player, passing a VideoItem.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the video playback when the page is created, triggering auto-play and expanding to full screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the video player page, including loading states, error handling, and video controls.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the placeholder poster image, either from asset or network, with loading and error handling.
